div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Views: home (fleet, activity chart), meters (list),
meter live tabs, meter history (trends, load profile,
billing, events, read cycles, device log)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Missing value: tile left out or '—'
Offline meter: values greyed (staleClass)
Refresh failing > 2 intervals: banner

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Completeness checks that exist:
firmware markers fill outages (max 7 days / 400 rows),
server dedupe, skipped profile count, read_failed / read_stale issues
